content.full_text: FAQ for students How do I enrol on my courses in the first semester? Full-time study programmes : you are automatically registered for almost all courses in the first semester according to the sample timetable . You only have to enrol on the courses for the supplementary and foreign language modules independently. Exception: Communication Design. Part-time study programmes : create your own timetable . If you have any questions, please contact the faculty administration or the programme counselling service. What access data do I need for course enrolment? You use your HTW Berlin login (user name and password) that you received when you enrolled. Why can't I enrol on a course in the LSF campus management system? Reasons may include: incorrect re-registration (semester fee not paid on time, unpaid late fee) restriction on re-registration due to missing health insurance notification no enrolment phase. Do I enrol on all courses via the LSF? Not always. Some courses are enrolled on outside the LSF. Information on this can be found in the respective LSF course description under “Notes on enrolment”. Do I have to register for each module course individually? You can only register for one course per module. If you are admitted to this course, you will automatically be admitted to all other courses in the module. The LSF shows exactly which courses you can register for and which courses you are automatically enrolled on. If there are several groups with different times scheduled in a course, you can select two groups and determine your preference for one of these. However, you only get one place — in one of the two groups. How does prioritisation work if multiple times are scheduled? Enter your preferred time as your first priority. If there is no space remaining in this group, the second priority is selected automatically. Without choosing a second priority, your chances of being allocated a place are reduced. What principle is used to allocate places? The allocation is made automatically according to an internal ranking — regardless of the time and date on which you register your enrolment requests in LSF. Special regulations exist for certain groups of students. Are there enrolment deadlines? Yes. Course enrolment runs in several phases. The exact dates can be found in the LSF portal . Can I change my enrolment at a later date? You can adjust your enrolment at any time during phase 1 and the remaining place allocation phase, but not afterwards. The date/time you do this within the phase does not affect the allocation of places. There is no guarantee of a place. Therefore, please pay attention to the enrolment figures in the LSF. Where can I find an overview of compulsory and elective courses? In the curriculum of your degree programme, which is included in your specific study regulations. Elective modules that are not offered every semester also exist. How do I find out about changes made by lecturers? You will be notified of any changes by email to your HTW Berlin email address. The register/de-register button is not active – why? The enrolment system is only accessible during the unlocked phases. Where can I get help? Instructions Organisational issues: faculty administration , for language modules Foreign Languages Centre Technical problems: IT help centre
